name: Parallels Desktop
summary: Parallels Desktop is a desktop virtualization application for macOS. Parallels Inc. publishes an explicit lifecycle table at kb.parallels.com/en/123560 with End of Maintenance, End of free email support, and End of Life dates for each major version.

notes: Tier: researched (AGENTS.md rule 8b). endoflife.date has no parallels-desktop slug (checked https://endoflife.date/api/all.json 2026-09-17: no parallels-desktop id) and data/products/ holds no parallels-desktop record. Parallels Inc. publishes an explicit lifecycle table at https://kb.parallels.com/en/123560 with End of Maintenance, End of free email support, and End of Life columns for 17 versions (PD 27 through PD 6). The vendor's 'End of Life' column (Last date license keys for renewals and upgrades can be purchased) is mapped to eol. PD 27, 26, and 20 show '–' in the End of Life column (not yet published), so eol is null for those. No GA dates are published. No eossec is separately published (the 'End of free email support' column is support-channel specific, not security-fix support, so it does not map to eossec per the AGENTS.md rule that a generic 'support' date never fills eossec). All eol dates are day-precision as published (vendor format DD-Mon-YYYY). Versions 21-25 are not yet published in the vendor table. All releases are excluded from OpenEoX export (eossec_unknown).
